Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTEXT / EVIDENCE: Driving gameplay; active goal remains regain/maintain pavement alignment and progress along the route. Screenshots are omitted: visual evidence consists of earlier agent descriptions, not independently inspected images. No finish/result/success/failure screen observed. Endpoint, completion conditions, actual route progress, global location and whether scenery repeats are unknown. Older history and the inherited summary's ending are truncated; do not reconstruct them. Action completion confirms execution only, not intended movement.

LATEST OBSERVED STATE / PENDING: Last described image: 1 mph, gear 1, on grass between trees, pavement below-right, nose upper-right, tree ahead-right. This followed S for 1s from 12 mph off-road, reducing displayed speed to 1. S+D for 1s then completed successfully, but NO subsequent screenshot is supplied. Resulting speed, gear/direction, heading, position and clearance are unknown. Its intended effect—back toward pavement while turning away from the tree—remains an unverified hypothesis.

CONTROLS / OBSERVED MECHANICS: All newly supplied actions were keyboard-only, 1s, and completed. Older S/S+D 0.5s and D 0.25/0.15s were accepted, not proven effective. W accelerates forward and can oppose reverse, but direction changes are inconsistent within one step: latest W from 2 R stopped at 0/gear 1; older W outcomes include remaining in reverse or transitioning forward. From the latest aligned pavement stop, consecutive W gave 0→15→27 (gear 2). W does not guarantee progress or heading retention: another W gave 11→4 with substantial view rotation, cause unknown; inherited W 12→5 occurred with puddle spray/rotation.
A/D steer while moving, but 1s corrections repeatedly undercorrect, overcorrect or cross verges. Steering alone is not reliable speed control: new A 6→10 and 9→12, D 16→18; D 10→6→4 and A 18→13 also occurred. Camera rotation complicates interpreting steering and road direction. Releasing steering does not ensure road-following.
S brakes and can establish reverse: new S 12→2, then 2→3 R; 0→4 R; 27/gear 2→14/N while remaining aligned; latest 12→1. S+D 2 forward→2 R. Braking plus steering can slow without preventing departure: S+A 10→2 at verge, 13→3 on grass; S+D 4→0 off-road. Reverse steering can accelerate quickly: S+D 3 R→7 R→10 R and 2 R→7 R; S+A 4 R→11 R. Reverse+D sometimes seemed to turn nose left and reverse+A rear toward road, but no universal rule is established.
Space is interpreted as handbrake, not independently identified. New space 10 R→6 R→0/R stopped only after leaving pavement; 11 R→2 R reached the pavement edge. Space+D 7 R→0/R stopped at the lower edge, but 12 forward→12 ended across the far verge on grass. Space+A 7→0 retained pavement once; space+D 9→7 reached pavement once. Neither braking method guarantees stopping before a verge or preserving alignment.

RECENT OBSERVED SEQUENCE: Numbers are mph; R denotes reported reverse. Arrows connect actions to subsequent observations, not guaranteed effects. Screen-relative directions can change with the camera.
1) Inherited pending W+A from 0 on grass resolved to 9/gear 1, red X, trunk partly obscuring car, pavement immediately ahead-left. Space+D→7 on pavement, nose upper-left toward verge, X present. Space+A→0 near right pavement edge, road upper-left/headlights on grass, X present. W+A→6 still near right edge. A→10 paved beside puddle, nose upper-left versus road upper-right, X absent. D→6 straddling verge, road upper-right behind large tree. D→4 at left edge, nose upper-right, immediate road right then left bend. W+D→9 paved, partly behind thin trunk, nose up versus road upper-left. A→12 grass facing trees. S→2 grass, pavement diagonally behind, trunk no longer obscuring. S→3 R grass, pavement behind-left/tree right.
2) S+D→7 R grass closer to pavement; repeat→10 R straddling right pavement edge, nose roughly toward upper-left road, red X. Space→6 R on grass/tree immediately right; repeat→0/R grass facing pavement running left-to-upper-right, X present. W+D→2/gear 1 grass facing pavement, little heading change, X present; repeat→10 paved near right edge, nose upper-right versus road upper-center, X absent. S+A→2 straddling edge, headlights toward grass/tree, pavement leftward behind. S+D→2 R near upper edge, nose toward grass, trunk immediately left. Repeat→7 R paved but nose nearly up across left-to-right road, rear nearing lower verge. Space+D→0/R at lower pavement edge, road upper-left.
3) W+A→2/gear 1 at lower edge, headlights across road; two STOPP banners beside road upper-left. Repeat→11 fully paved, nose slightly upper-left roughly along road, banners by left bend. W→4 near upper edge pointing toward grass, road upper-right past banners, red indicator lights; cause of slowdown/rotation unknown. S+D→0/gear 1 grass directly before STOPP banner, pavement behind, trees right. S→4 R grass right of pavement, banner ahead/tree immediately right. S+A→11 R still grass, pavement left/tree ahead. Space→2 R straddling upper edge, facing grass/banners, road left-to-right. S+D→2 R paved near left edge, nose roughly along road upper-right.
4) W→0/gear 1 on pavement near left edge, pointing up road, puddles ahead/right. W→15 maintained pavement alignment; W→27/gear 2 splashing through puddle at left edge. S→14/N paved and aligned, puddles behind. W→16/gear 1 straddling left edge, most road ahead to right. D→18 paved, nose upper-right versus immediate road upper-left. A→13 beyond right edge facing grass, road upper-left. S+A→3 grass immediately right of pavement, nose upper-left toward road. W+A→6 still grass, tree immediately right/pavement ahead-left. W→12 on pavement but pointing upper-left across road extending right past puddles, red indicator lights. Space+D→12 grass facing trees, pavement behind. S→1 grass between trees, pavement below-right/nose upper-right. S+D then completed; outcome pending.
